data.one_liner: Strongly‑typed immutable FHIR R4B resource and data‑type models for Dart/Flutter with JSON/YAML/XML support.
data.what_it_does: The package provides Dart classes for every FHIR R4B resource and primitive type, generated from the official specification. It includes utilities for serialization, deserialization, validation and copy‑with immutability.
use_when: Building healthcare or interoperability apps that need to consume or produce FHIR R4B data
You need type‑safe, immutable models with built‑in JSON/YAML/XML conversion
avoid_when: Your app does not interact with FHIR or healthcare standards
You need a minimal‑size library for simple data transfer
strengths: Full coverage of the FHIR R4B spec
Strong typing and validation of all elements
Immutable models with copyWith and deep equality
Built‑in support for JSON, YAML and XML
weaknesses: Large API surface can increase app size
Steep learning curve for developers unfamiliar with FHIR

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic JSON serialization code‑gen for custom models, useful if you only need simple data classes without the full FHIR spec
